environment.description: AWS Lambda (Node.js 18.x) deployed via internal platform team's hardened container image. The Lambda extension layer includes a custom eBPF-based runtime enforcement agent (internal tool 'lambda-sentinel' v2.3.1) that applies a seccomp-bpf profile restricting syscalls. The profile denies write(2) and openat(2) to paths outside /var/task/** (read-only) and blocks timing side-channels by enforcing constant-time response padding at the extension layer — all HTTP responses are held until a fixed 150ms window boundary before being returned through the API Gateway integration. The enforcement agent's profile manifest (sentinel-policy.yaml) specifies 'timing_normalization: fixed_window_ms: 150' and 'fs_policy: deny_write: [/tmp/**, /var/**, /proc/**]'. API Gateway is configured with a usage plan limiting to 10 requests/second per API key with burst of 5.

config.api_gateway: REST API with usage plan, 10 req/s, burst 5, API key required
